entities.name: Bevacizumab
observations: Anti-VEGF antibody evaluated with platinum-doublet chemotherapy for advanced non-squamous NSCLC.

entities.name: Advanced non-squamous NSCLC
observations: Chinese advanced or recurrent non-squamous NSCLC was the population in the BEYOND randomized trial.

entities.name: PMID:26014294
observations: Chinese phase III randomized, double-blind BEYOND trial compared bevacizumab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel with chemotherapy alone in advanced/recurrent non-squamous NSCLC.

entities.name: BEYOND efficacy
observations: In 276 Chinese patients, bevacizumab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel improved median PFS (9.2 vs 6.5 months; HR 0.40, 95% CI 0.29–0.54), ORR (54% vs 26%), and median OS (24.3 vs 17.7 months; HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.50–0.93) versus chemotherapy alone.

entities.name: PMID:31814679
observations: Chinese retrospective propensity-score-matched cohort compared first-line pemetrexed-platinum with or without bevacizumab; median PFS favored bevacizumab (matched cohort 9.8 vs 6.6 months, P<0.001). Residual confounding limits causal inference.
